$comment: Field-level privacy classification of every column the migrations create (ZTAX-PRIV-001 §24, §33; G-PRIV-01; ZTAX-PRIV-REQ-0001 to 0003). migrations/catalog_test.go replays the up migrations and fails on any column missing here, any entry for a column that does not exist, and any entry that is not valid privacy.Metadata: the rules the contract lint applies to API fields. A column is classified in the same change that creates it. The vocabulary is contracts/privacy/vocabulary.json. Columns with only a class are P0.

accumulator_key.note: Opaque key (ADR-0004 §7.2, grammar pending OBL-001). A key that ever encodes a customer identity is reclassified here first.

running_total.note: An aggregate across a tenant's transactions for one key.

subject_id.note: A user id, session id or tenant slug as text; the subject itself is resolved through the audited path.

detail.note: Canonical JSON of what changed. The sign-in record carries user agent and client IP, so the column takes the highest class it can hold. No credential material and no fiscal amount.

user_id.note: Identifies a human principal. Logged as ztx.subject.

email.note: Work email and sign-in handle; carried in Go as privacy.Value.

password_verifier.note: Argon2id PHC string. Not replayable, and still a credential.

source.note: Attribution of reference geography; names a publisher, never a person.

confirmed_by.note: The human who confirmed an AI-sourced classification (ADR-0006 §2.6).

amount.note: One decision's contribution, not an aggregate.

document_number.note: The legal document number a customer holds; it identifies their transaction.

ext_value.note: The customer's own document reference; may be a subscriber account or invoice number.

recorded_by.note: The operator who committed the document; NULL for system work.

source_line_ref.note: The billing system's line reference; may carry an account or order number.

response_body.note: The verbatim response replayed to a retry; carries whatever the fiscal response carried.

boundary.note: Reference geography of a taxing jurisdiction, not a customer location.

amount.note: A per-decision entry, not an aggregate.

name.note: A legal entity's registered name; a company, not a natural person. Reclassified here first if sole traders are onboarded.

assessed_amount.note: A tenant's liability for a period; an aggregate.

recorded_by.note: The user who moved the obligation; NULL when a commit wrote the row.

payload.note: Event payload; may carry decision facts until relayed.

last_error.note: Relay transport error text; the relay records broker errors, never payload values.

token_digest.note: SHA-256 of the session secret. It resolves a session, so it is treated as the credential.

revoked_reason.note: System-chosen text such as 'signed out'; no user input.

user_agent.note: Client identifier, recorded for the admin session list only.

client_ip.note: IP address, recorded for the admin session list only; never used for authentication or situs.

input_canonical.note: The canonical determination input; may carry a natural person's transaction facts.

trace.note: Execution trace (ADR-0005 §2.7); evidence, retained with the decision.

amount.note: A control-ledger amount in aggregate tax terms; carries no customer identity.

slug.note: Tenant handle; may carry a sole trader's name. Logged as-is by bootstrap and sign-in audit, which P1 permits.

display_name.note: Business name; a natural person's name for a sole trader.

reason.note: Free text entered by an administrator.

running_total.note: An aggregate across a tenant's transactions for one key.

threshold_amount.note: A limit from content, not a customer value.

amount.note: One decision's tax assessed into a period's return; an aggregate input.
Tax returned on one decision; a per-transaction figure, not an aggregate.

payment_reference.note: The payment provider's reference for the refunded payment; it can identify a payer's transaction.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator; may name the customer.

requested_by.note: The user who requested the refund; NULL for system work.

external_reference.note: The provider's reference for its report on the refund.

recorded_by.note: The user who recorded the provider's report; NULL for system work.

url.note: A customer's endpoint. The path or query may carry a customer identifier; logs carry it redacted.

description.note: Free text entered by an administrator.

created_by.note: The administrator who created the webhook; NULL for system work.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who changed the status.

sealed_secret.note: A signing secret, sealed under the cell's webhook key. Never logged, never returned after the response that issued it.

created_by.note: The administrator who issued the secret.

body.note: The CloudEvent as sent; carries what the event's payload carries, amounts included for refunds and threshold crossings.

replayed_by.note: The administrator who replayed the delivery; NULL on a fan-out.

error.note: The transport's error class, truncated; never the response body.

requested_by.note: The operator who submitted the batch.

request.note: A queued commit's canonical request: the same transaction input a decision's envelope records.

recorded_by.note: The operator whose act moved the document; NULL when a correction's commit did.

body.note: The period's sealed population: journal and document ids, control balances, open exceptions. Aggregates, and ids that resolve to fiscal records.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator.

requested_by.note: The operator who asked to reopen the period.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator.

recorded_by.note: The operator who moved the period; on a reopening, the requester.

approved_by.note: The second person who approved a reopening.

ran_by.note: The operator who ran the reconciliation.

match_key.note: A canonical id the stage compares on: a decision or refund id, never a customer reference.

expected.note: One decision's or refund's tax as one stage expects it.

observed.note: The same, as the next stage observed it.

detail.note: A sentence the comparison wrote; carries no amount.

resolver.note: The person who resolved the exception.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator.

evidence.note: References to the evidence a resolution relies on: document ids, ticket numbers.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who recorded the policy version.

matter.note: The claim, investigation or request the hold serves, as an operator named it.

placed_by.note: The administrator who placed the hold.

reason.note: Free text entered by an operator.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who placed, changed or released the hold.

matters.note: Forms or matters the grant covers, as the customer named them.

representative.note: The individual or entity acting under the grant.

evidence.note: References to the signed artifact, consent proof or authority acknowledgement.

credential_ref.note: Where the authority credential is held in the secrets vault. Never the credential.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who recorded the grant.

reason.note: Free text entered by an administrator.

recorded_by.note: The administrator who granted, revoked or superseded the authorization.

created_by.note: The person who instantiated the compliance package.

control_total.note: A tenant's liability for a period as prepared for filing; an aggregate.

authority_ref.note: The authority's receipt or reference number for a submission.

evidence.note: The authority's response as received, or the operator's account of what the authority answered.

note.note: Free text entered by a preparer, reviewer, approver or operator.

recorded_by.note: The person who prepared, reviewed, approved, submitted or recorded the step.

account_ref.note: A vault or token reference to the payee's account details; never the account number.

source.note: The official instruction the payee details were taken from.

created_by.note: The person who entered the payee details.

evidence.note: How a verification confirmed the details against the authority's official source.

recorded_by.note: The person who verified, suspended or superseded the version.

amount.note: A tenant's tax liability for a period, as instructed for payment; an aggregate.

funding_ref.note: A vault or token reference to the customer's own funding account; never the account number.

created_by.note: The person who made the payment instruction.

provider_ref.note: The provider's or authority's reference for a payment.

raw.note: The provider's response as received, or the operator's account of it.

note.note: Free text entered by an approver or operator.

recorded_by.note: The person who approved, submitted or recorded the step.

limitations.note: Known limitations of the comparator, entered by a person.

created_by.note: The person who recorded the comparator profile.

compared_value.note: Aggregate tax value compared in the run.

absolute_variance.note: Aggregate absolute variance of the run.

created_by.note: The person who executed the run.

comparator_total.note: A transaction's tax total as the comparator computed it.

zoiko_total.note: A transaction's tax total as ZoikoTax decided it.

variance.note: The difference between the two totals.

components.note: Tax components compared, by code and slot, as decimal strings.

note.note: Free text from the person investigating the discrepancy.

recorded_by.note: The person who moved the discrepancy.

created_by.note: The person who created the migration program.

records.note: Historical tax results as the source held them: source ids, document dates, currencies and amounts. The API accepts no personal fields.

control_totals.note: Aggregate amounts the source declared, by currency.

created_by.note: The person who registered the snapshot.
The person who recorded the mapping version.
The person who executed the run.

total.note: A historical document's tax total as the source recorded it.

components.note: Historical tax components by ZoikoTax slot.

note.note: Why an exception was resolved or accepted as a residual.

decided_by.note: The person who decided the exception.

recorded_by.note: The person who moved the cutover.
